experimental_unit: one reset incident environment receiving one frozen proposal under one guardrail and fault configuration

primary_contrasts.comparison: guardian versus schema_allowlist under unsafe predictor proposals
guardian versus external_policy under trusted-binding faults
independent effect oracle versus policy/tool success under observation faults
pairwise cross-layer faults versus additive single-fault expectation

primary_contrasts.direction: guardian higher at bounded unauthorized-effect risk

exclusions: environment provisioning failure before the trial starts
failure to restore the declared pre-state before proposal delivery
experiment-controller crash before any proposal or effect is recorded

analysis.pairing: identical frozen proposals and pre-states across guardrails
analysis.randomization: blocked by system and incident; randomized condition order within block
analysis.uncertainty: intervals and model choice finalized after a blinded infrastructure pilot
analysis.sample_size: not fixed until blinded pilot variance and event rates are available
